entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is next submitted that petitioner was a bank employee and is uncle of the husband of the OP No. 2 and from perusal of the allegation as alleged in the FIR, it would manifest that no specific allegation has been alleged against the petitioner rather the allegations are general and omnibus in nature.

The learned counsel further submits that except for the name of the petitioner in the FIR,
nothing has been alleged against him.
The learned counsel next submits that petitioner was working as a Cash Officer with SBI and retired in the year 2016.

It is further submitted that petitioner was separate in mess and property from the husband of the OP No. 2 and even from his own brother,
who is father-in-law of the OP No. 2.

The learned counsel thus submits that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations and even the learned trial court, while taking cognizance, acts mechanically.
7.

It is made clear at the cost of repetition that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.59820 of 2017(2)
dt.14-12-2023 further proceeding before the learned trial court has been stayed only with respect to the petitioner herein.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) SUMIT/-
